settings.title: About Rosalia
settings.content:
Rosalia — the daily reset for reactive skin.

Redness isn't a flaw to hide. It's a signal — an overactive immune response your skin is asking you to hear.

Rosalia was built for the women who've tried everything: cortisone creams that thin the skin, prescription treatments that stop working, drugstore serums that promise calm and deliver burn.

One serum. Five clinical actives. Formulated for barrier repair, calibrated for daily use, tested on skin that reacts to almost everything.

You deserve skincare that respects your skin's memory.
